title: The Uli Dataset: An Exercise in Experience Led Annotation of oGBV

bias_targets.methodology: Creating an expert-annotated multilingual dataset (Hindi, Tamil, Indian English) of tweets to detect online gender-based violence (oGBV), misogyny, and sexism, and evaluating transformer models (IndicBERT, XLM-T) on their detection performance.

Including transphobic and queerphobic abuse within the dataset annotation guidelines for gendered abuse, labeled by expert annotators from the LGBTQIA+ community, to train and evaluate detection models.
